subject: learning/ci-memory-workflow-retirement
statement: The Forgejo source-workflow renderer excludes the standalone memory-reconciliation template; the required docs-gate still verifies memory on every PR and mainline push.
intent: Remove duplicate CI execution while preserving the shared local and hosted memory predicate.
rationale: The template is retained as captured authored source until memory retirement can seal its lineage, but the renderer skips it so new Forgejo source installations have no duplicate memory workflow.
fit_criterion: Materialization emits eight workflows and no memory-reconciliation workflow; ci-parity confirms docs-gate still includes the shared memory group.
learned_from: The 40-PR Actions audit found the standalone workflow repeated docs-gate memory work on PRs and mainline pushes.
